text: On the ethics_justice testbed, we evaluated a weak-to-strong method that derives multi-template margin signals from the frozen strong base model, measuring performance gap recovered (PGR) across 16 seeds. The observed PGR is 0.51. No baseline PGR was supplied with this run, so we cannot characterize this figure as an improvement over, or a regression from, any comparison method; it should be read only as the absolute level of gap recovery achieved by this configuration. Likewise, no standard error or per-seed spread was reported, so the dispersion of the 16-seed distribution around 0.51 is unknown, and we cannot attach any statement about the precision or stability of the estimate. Interpreting the number as roughly half the available weak-to-strong gap recovered is therefore the strongest claim the data supports. Follow-up work should record a matched baseline and seed-level variance so that the margin-signal approach can be compared directly and its uncertainty quantified.
